title: Little Play Garden
shortDescription: Eight offline Persian games for ages 3–5. Play with a grown-up.
fullDescription:
Little Play Garden brings together eight picture-based games for children around ages 3–5. All in-game language is Persian (Farsi). Play alongside your child while exploring familiar sounds, colors, shapes, small quantities and everyday actions.

The collection includes:
• Who Made That Sound? — match an animal call to its picture
• Picture Detective — find the friend performing the requested action
• Color Baskets — move each fruit to the matching basket
• Shape House — match shapes across different orientations
• Lunch for Three Friends — give exactly one fruit to each friend
• Feed the Rabbit — choose one to three carrots to match a picture
• Little Puzzle — assemble a three-piece picture
• Big and Small — find the requested size

Visual cues, large touch targets and clear picture-based responses support play without reading. Correct answers receive a short visual celebration. A mistake keeps the challenge available for another try, without negative scores. Matching activities support both dragging and selecting a piece before tapping its destination.

Games, illustrations, fonts and gameplay sounds are bundled in the app. Playing does not require an internet connection. The collection menu supports portrait and landscape, while games are designed for landscape play.

This release has no advertising, in-app purchases, user accounts or online chat. A parent area provides settings and app information.

Shared play is encouraged: try the same idea again with real objects or toys after the game. These activities provide opportunities to practice and explore; they are not a developmental assessment or a substitute for professional advice.

Device requirements: Android 8.0 or newer and Android System WebView 105 or newer. A grown-up may need to update an older WebView before playing; that device update may require internet.
